en.projects.title: MyStar — Taking Staroptic from physical retail to e-commerce
en.projects.intro: I built MyStar from the ground up as Staroptic’s dedicated Shopify storefront, creating a structured bilingual sales channel for eyewear and prescription ordering.
en.projects.meta.label: Project metadata
en.projects.ownership: Sole Developer · Built from the Ground Up
en.projects.context.title: Business Context
en.projects.context.copy: Staroptic is an established optical retailer that launched MyStar as its dedicated online brand and sales channel.
en.projects.challenge.title: Challenge
en.projects.challenge.copy: The storefront needed to organize a complex eyewear catalogue and translate key parts of the in-store optical sales process into a clear online journey.
en.projects.role.title: My Role
en.projects.role.copy: I led the storefront architecture, Shopify and frontend development, UX/UI decisions, localization, technical SEO, app integration, QA and ongoing improvements.

en.process.text1: As a frontend and Shopify developer, I approach every project as a performance-first digital product. From technical SEO and responsive design to clean architecture and polished UI, every decision is made to create websites and eCommerce experiences that are fast, discoverable, scalable, and built to support real business growth.

en.process.step1.title: Understand the Brand & Goal
en.process.step1.desc: I start by understanding the business, brand positioning, audience, and exact goal of the project. Whether it is a Shopify store, landing page, or custom platform, clarity at this stage shapes everything that follows.
en.process.step2.title: Plan for Structure & Scalability
en.process.step2.desc: Before development begins, I define the right structure for the project: layout logic, content hierarchy, responsive behavior, Shopify setup, and technical foundations that support performance, SEO, and long-term scalability.

with foundations that support performance, SEO and scale.
en.process.step3.title: Build with Precision
en.process.step3.desc: I develop clean, maintainable interfaces with close attention to detail. Every section is built to feel refined, load fast, work across devices, and support a smooth user experience from the first interaction to the final conversion point.

en.process.step4.title: Optimize for Performance & SEO
en.process.step4.desc: Optimization is part of the build, not an afterthought. I refine Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, accessibility, responsiveness, and overall usability so the final product is not only visually strong, but also discoverable and efficient.
process.step4.desc.lines: Optimization is part of the build, not an afterthought.

en.process.step5.title: Launch, Refine & Support
en.process.step5.desc: After launch, I make sure everything is stable, polished, and ready for real use. From final testing and adjustments to handoff and post-launch support, the goal is a product that performs well today and stays easy to grow tomorrow.

sr.process.label: Kako radim
sr.process.text1: Kao frontend i Shopify developerka, svakom projektu pristupam kao digitalnom proizvodu u kome performanse imaju prioritet. Od tehničkog SEO-a i responzivnog dizajna do čiste arhitekture i doteranog UI-ja, svaka odluka usmerena je ka tome da sajtovi i eCommerce iskustva budu brzi, lako pronalažljivi, skalabilni i spremni da podrže konkretne poslovne ciljeve.
sr.process.text2: Bilo da razvijam prilagođeni Shopify storefront, optimizujem landing stranicu usmerenu na konverzije ili gradim veću web aplikaciju, moj proces ostaje isti: jasna komunikacija, promišljeno planiranje, pristupačnost, Core Web Vitals i održiv kod koji pouzdano radi i nakon lansiranja.

sr.process.step1.desc: Počinjem razumevanjem biznisa, pozicioniranja brenda, publike i konkretnog cilja projekta. Bilo da je u pitanju Shopify prodavnica, landing stranica ili prilagođena platforma, jasno definisana osnova u ovoj fazi određuje kvalitet svega što sledi.

process.step2.desc.lines: uz tehničke osnove koje podržavaju performanse i SEO.

sr.process.step3.desc: Razvijam čist i održiv interfejs sa velikom pažnjom prema detaljima. Svaka sekcija osmišljena je tako da izgleda profesionalno, učitava se brzo, radi pouzdano na svim uređajima i vodi korisnika od prvog kontakta do konverzije.

sr.process.step4.desc: Optimizacija je deo razvoja, a ne korak koji dolazi na kraju. Unapređujem Core Web Vitals, tehnički SEO, pristupačnost, responzivnost i ukupnu upotrebljivost kako bi finalni proizvod bio vizuelno ubedljiv, lako pronalažljiv i operativno efikasan.
